artifact_review: The Router identified a texture anomaly in the bottom lens (severity 1.5) and perspective distortion in the background (severity 1.0). I agree with these findings. The bottom lens lacks the crisp, mirror-like reflection expected of glass/plastic, appearing 'muddy' or smeared, which is a common AI artifact in transparent/reflective surfaces. The background architecture shows slight waviness in vertical lines, indicating minor geometric instability. The topology mask shows some jagged edges on the right side of the housing, suggesting slight boundary uncertainty, but no major fusion. The perceptual quality auditor found no global distortions, which supports the view that artifacts are localized and subtle.

Secondary artifacts include slight perspective warping in the background building lines (Severity ~1.0). These are noticeable upon close inspection but do not constitute structural failures. The image is far superior to the 'mid' reference (altar) in terms of artifact absence, but not quite 'perfect' like the 'high' reference (rifle) due to the lens texture issue.
